project.name: Addo Elephant Bridge Over Road and Rail
project.description: Wildlife crossing bridge (ecoduct) over road and rail infrastructure at Addo Elephant National Park. Consists of two tunnels - a vehicle tunnel and a rail tunnel - with earth-filled bridge deck for elephant and wildlife crossing.

scope.special_instructions: Wildlife crossing infrastructure - specialist environmental considerations apply. Two separate tunnel structures (car and rail).

geological_assessment.notes: Eastern Cape location - no dolomite risk

regulatory_overlay.notes: National park location - environmental compliance required

supply_chain_intelligence.notes: Shukuma estimates already received - specialist supplier identified

architectural.filename: DP3976 ADDO ELEPHANT BRIDGE-SP-001C Site Plan Elevations.PDF
architectural.title: Site Layout Plan
architectural.notes: Shows overall bridge layout with car and rail tunnels, L11 Terra-Force blocks, site section. Total bridge length ~233m.

architectural.filename: DP3976 ADDO ELEPHANT BRIDGE-SP-002D Sections Elevations.PDF
architectural.title: Typical Sections and Elevations
architectural.notes: Enlarged sections through vehicle and train tunnels, side elevations, Terraforce block wall detail, wall footing detail. Shows stone wall cladding, 120mm Shukuma wall panels.

structural.filename: DP3976 ADDO ELEPHANT BRIDGE-F-001 Fndn Car.pdf
structural.title: Road Tunnel Foundation Plan and Details
structural.notes: Road tunnel foundation and column layout, reinforcing layout, typical section through foundation. Foundation length ~87m, width varies. Cover to concrete 50mm.

structural.filename: DP3976 ADDO ELEPHANT BRIDGE-F-002 Fndn Rail.pdf
structural.title: Rail Tunnel Foundation Plan and Details
structural.notes: Rail tunnel foundation and column layout, reinforcing layout. Similar configuration to car tunnel. Cover to concrete 50mm.

structural.filename: DP3976 ADDO ELEPHANT BRIDGE-S-01P-C Section Car RevC.PDF
structural.title: Car Tunnel Typical Details Structural Steelwork in Portal
structural.notes: Section through car tunnel at 1:50. Shows 120mm Shukuma panels, 5-250mm thick flooring and 24-200mm thick flooring (2950kg Type F). Main struts 254x146x31UC. Tubular bracing details. Steel to SABS 1200 H, welds to SABS 0147-1984 and 044 specs. All structural steelwork Grade S355JR.

structural.filename: DP3976 ADDO ELEPHANT BRIDGE-S-02P Steel at End Walls.pdf
structural.title: Car Tunnel Typical Details Structural Steelwork in End Walls
structural.notes: Inside and outside elevation on headwall. 100x100 T sections, 200x75x25 PFC, 254x146x31UB columns/posts, 305x165x46UB, 152x152x30UC. Fibre cement boards 1800mm x 2400mm fixed with M8 Post-drive screws.

structural.filename: DP3976 ADDO ELEPHANT BRIDGE-S-02P-A Steel at End Walls RevA.PDF
structural.title: Car Tunnel Typical Details Structural Steelwork in End Walls
structural.notes: Revised version of S-002P with Shukuma panels revision. Same steelwork details.

structural.filename: DP3976 ADDO ELEPHANT BRIDGE-S-02SP Schukuma at End Walls.PDF
structural.title: Road and Rail Tunnels Typical Details of Shukuma Panels in End Walls
structural.notes: Shukuma gable panel layout for both tunnels. Road tunnel: 16517mm width. Rail tunnel: 13168mm width. All panels 150mm thick with Wire F.

structural.filename: DP3976 ADDO ELEPHANT BRIDGE-S-03P A Section RAIL Portal Steel.PDF
structural.title: Train Tunnel Typical Details Structural Steelwork in Portal
structural.notes: Section through train tunnel. 6-250mm thick Shukuma flooring and 18-200mm thick (2950kg Type F). 457x191x67UB rafters, 305x165x46UB columns. All bracing members #102x4.5 SHS. All gussets 8mm and end plates 10mm. All bolts M16GR8.8.

structural.filename: DP3976 ADDO ELEPHANT BRIDGE-S-04P-A Elevation RAIL Headwalls.PDF
structural.title: Train Tunnel Typical Details Structural Steelwork in Headwalls
structural.notes: Inside and outside elevation on headwall for train tunnel. IPE 200 sections throughout. 254x146x31UB posts, 305x165x46UB, 152x152x30UC. Fibre cement boards 1800mm x 2400mm.

schedules.title: Shukuma Revised Estimate - Car Tunnel
schedules.notes: Shukuma flooring estimate. Slab 200F: 1720m², Slab 250H+2: 478m², Slab 120B: 778m², Slab 150F: 248m². Core Open: 800m. Total Value: R3,182,572 excl VAT (R3,659,957.80 incl). Rate/m²: R987.15. Engineer: Andries Stücki Pr. Eng. Estimate valid 120 days.

schedules.title: Shukuma Revised Estimate - Train Tunnel
schedules.notes: Shukuma flooring estimate. Slab 200F: 1816m², Slab 250H+2: 765m², Slab 150F: 370m². Core Open: 800m. Total Value: R3,098,729.79 excl VAT (R3,563,539.26 incl). Rate/m²: R1,050.06. Engineer: Andries Stücki Pr. Eng. Estimate valid 120 days.
